item.description: ✴️ Tom Lee, co-founder of Fundstrat and chairman of BitMine, predicts that Ethereum (ETH) could surge to between $7,000 and $9,000 by early 2026, potentially reaching as high as $20,000 in the future. He attributes this optimism to the growth of tokenization and the increasing adoption of stablecoins. Ethereum's blockchain is the primary host for most stablecoins and is a leading platform for tokenization trends, with a substantial amount of assets being digitized on its network. Lee believes that ETH has entered a "super cycle" that could last 10 to 15 years.
